verdict.rationale: Lorikeet lets users build and deploy natural-language and deterministic workflows that take actions through APIs and MCP servers, including via natural language from an AI assistant. Guardrails can also block, rewrite or escalate in response to incoming messages, and outbound campaigns run on scheduled cadences. These are event-driven automations scoped to customer conversations rather than a general rules engine. Missing for 10: an explicit rule/trigger configuration model (event types, conditions, actions), documentation of non-conversation event triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
